page.layout: One page of text above a framed set of three stacked woodcut scenes; a margin note at the right beside the first italic line; catchword-style signature "CAP." at lower right below the image.

main_text.p: mulierculam redituraм exspectans, & nequa elaberetur. Ad eum seruus alter:

p.i: Credo ego istoc tibi exemplo eundum esse actu- Milite.tum extra portam,

main_text.p: Dispesis manibus, patibulum cùm habebis. Benè est, inquit. forma & status in te, qui mox erit; cùm herus alligatum te patibulo per vrbem ducet. Atquin stetisse ego eum opinor, manibus ante se proiectis & leuiter diductis, habitu quo solent captantes & apprehensuri.

page.notes: The woodcut shows three stacked scenes of a man carrying a patibulum (cross-beam) pursued by soldiers and a bound figure; no printed text inside the image. The catchword "CAP." is set at lower right and is a signature-like mark. The first line's final word in the margin "Milite." is a side note. Uncertain: "redituraм" contains a Cyrillic-looking letter in the OCR and should read "redituraм" as printed "rediturām" with macron; kept as printed.
